QuestInfo.name: Descended from Warriors
QuestInfo.0: You met a man in #m102030200# who appears to be a warrior of Perion.
QuestInfo.1: Test your abilities by hunting 200 Iron Boars.
QuestInfo.2:
You defeated 200 Iron Boars pretty easily.
Guess you've grown a lot as an Explorer.
But you will never stop training!

0.0: It's dangerous here. Go back to town.\r\n#L0##bExcuse me, but what are you doing here?#l\n#k
0.1: I'm training, of course. I hunt stronger and stronger monsters to bring a sense of safety to the town.\r\n#L0##bThen I can help you!#l\n#k
0.2: You? Can you really take on the Iron Boars here?

yes.0: Well, at least you're not a coward. Prove your strength and courage! Eliminate 200 Iron Boars.

no.0: That's fine. You'll feel yourself getting stronger with just a little bit more training.

1.0: Are there 200 fewer Iron Boars in the world?

yes.0: Not bad. Keep training, for you never know when Maple World will need you to keep the peace.

mob.0: Pathetic! A real hero has the patience to take down 200 Iron Boars. I could do that in my sleep.
